newsitem.title: GERMANY: Depfa eager to expand through acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Depfa eager to expand through acquisitions.

text.p: Depfa-Bank AG said on Wednesday it was keen to expand via acquisitions to take advantage of what it said would be substantial changes in the banking sector with the advent of Europe's single currency.

"(To benefit from these changes) It is necessary for Depfa-Bank to expand though the acquisition of other high-yielding institutions," Thilo Koepfler, the bank's chief executive told an annual meeting.
Koepfler added that DePfa, one of the largest private sector bond issuers in Europe, had sounded out certain possible acquisitions, but gave no further details.
Europe hopes to launch the euro single currency in 1999.

Koepfler also said the bank had made a good start to 1997, with profits before risk provisions rising by 11 percent to 167 million marks. In 1996, DePfa posted a 45.3 percent leap in profits before provisions to 466.5 million marks.
